summary: List the public evidence signing keys of two trusted build hosts under invented host names

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this lists two public keys in a trust file.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. No skip policy admits the host trust level yet and every check stays enforce false, so the keys vouch for nothing today.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this change. The host owners keep their signer configuration matching the listed names.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
